**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 24 already delivers our preferred assignment position:

- **§ 24.1** — we may assign to an Affiliate or to an M&A/reorganization/asset-sale successor without Vendor consent (notice + assumption only).
- **§ 24.2** — Vendor is restricted asymmetrically: no assignment, delegation of material performance, or transfer by change of control without our consent, and never to a direct competitor of ours.
- **§ 24.3** — scoped to "other assignments," so the residual mutual-consent requirement does **not** swallow the § 24.1 carve-out (the specific planner concern).
- **§ 24.4** — no Vendor right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees, or reduce service on our change of control, plus a cooperation obligation for successor administration.
- **§ 13.3** — licence transfer rights track a Section 24 permitted assignment, so the carve-out is not defeated at the licence level.

I also confirmed no back-door change-of-control trigger elsewhere: the only other relevant provision is the standard insolvency termination in § 9.2, which expressly excludes a lawful reorganization that does not impair performance.
